parts.html: The K-35 kitchen model combines a contemporary straight-line layout with light wood-effect upper cabinets and dark grey-brown lower and tall side units. The defining feature of this design is the contrast between the bright central working area and the darker cabinetry surrounding it.

The light wood-effect finish introduces warmth and texture, while the solid grey-brown fronts give the kitchen a calm, structured appearance. This combination works particularly well in contemporary apartments, private residences, and open-plan kitchen-living areas, where the cabinetry forms part of the overall interior composition.

K-35 has a linear length of 4.6 meters. Its straight-line configuration arranges the main kitchen functions along one wall. Upper and lower cabinets, tall side units, work surfaces, and spaces for built-in appliances form a unified furniture composition.

In the supplied visualization, the central section is defined by light wood-effect upper cabinets and a matching wood-look backsplash. Dark grey-brown lower cabinets and tall side units frame this lighter area, creating a clear distinction between the working zone and the surrounding cabinetry.

A built-in oven is positioned within the tall cabinetry on the left. The sink and hob are arranged along the main worktop. During individual planning, appliance and sink positions can be adapted to the room dimensions and existing electrical and plumbing connections.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard, but have different finishes. The central upper cabinets feature a light wood-effect decor, while the lower cabinets and tall side units have a dark grey-brown solid-color finish.

The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based. The wood-grain appearance comes from decorative finishes rather than solid timber in the stated standard specification.

Hinged cabinet doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are equipped with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration.
Lift mechanisms, pull-out cargo storage, and a separate kitchen island are not included in the standard K-35 specification.

K-35 can be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, clients can choose more functional furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems. Alternative materials are also available, ranging from budget-friendly options to premium finishes. Cabinet fronts, countertop materials, wood-effect tones, solid-color finishes, and internal storage can be selected according to individual requirements and project budget.
K-35 Kitchen Specifications — Standard Configuration
Color: Grey, with dark grey-brown lower cabinetry and tall side units
Style: Contemporary
Configuration: Straight-line / single-wall kitchen
Countertop: Chipboard-based
Dimensions: 4.6 × 2.3 × 0.6 m
Lift mechanism: None
Appliances: Designed for built-in appliances
Cargo storage: No
Handles: Included
Upper cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with a light wood-effect finish in the central section
Lower cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with a dark grey-brown solid-color finish
Cabinet construction: 18 mm laminated particleboard
Linear length: 4.6 m
Kitchen island: No
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close
Finish: Mixed — light wood-effect surfaces and dark grey-brown cabinetry
Drawer runners: Muller telescopic runners without soft-close

Optional upgrades: more functional hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, additional storage systems, and materials ranging from budget-friendly to premium. These options are selected separately from the standard specification.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-35 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, with adjustments to the length of the kitchen, cabinet arrangement, appliance positions, and internal storage. Clients can also choose alternative combinations of wood-effect and solid-color finishes, cabinet and countertop materials, and furniture hardware.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
